definitions.explanation: The standard of something when compared to other things.

examples.japanese: この{製品|せいひん}は{質|しつ}が{良|い}い。
examples.english: This product is of good quality.

examples.japanese: {量|りょう}より{質|しつ}が{大切|たいせつ}だ。
examples.english: Quality is more important than quantity.

notes: Often paired with {量|りょう} (quantity) in discussions about quality vs quantity.
